architecture: real F1/F2 truth -> bounded Gold SH/ND visual proxies -> existing world draw seam

proofs.f1: slot index maps 1:1 to SH index; stable real node id maps to bounded ND storage; real coordinates/state/timeline remain authoritative
proofs.p17: node proxies copy real x/y/rot exactly and Gold drawNodeBody applies that transform; numerical multi-position/rotation proof tolerance 1e-12
proofs.f2: Preview/Local pulse real node; Capture binds the actual escrow.p identity; MirrorEscrowImage enables destination image; MirrorRouteEmerge deletes the binding
proofs.sameObject: route bindings key the exact HR.match.world.mirrorF2.escrow[].p object and never create a projectile clone
proofs.fallback: MirrorRouteEmerge via entry-fallback pulses captured entry only; adapter performs no destination selection or retarget
proofs.isolation: state and fixed SH/ND pools are per combatant; render order is combatant idx then slot/node id
proofs.resources: no frame canvas/Image/Gold allocation; maps bounded by real escrow; teardown clears bindings and all proxies
